record.title: Q1 Linux Kernel Multi Segment Range Demo Vulnerability
record.description: Demo vulnerability with multiple affected kernel ranges.
record.affected_versions: 4.11 <= Linux Kernel < 5.10.255 5.12 <= Linux Kernel < 5.15.205 5.16 <= Linux Kernel < 6.1.171
record.remediation: Upgrade to a kernel version outside the affected ranges.
